name: Terre de Femmes International Award
summary: A €10,000 grant for each of two nature projects led by a woman or a group of women through a non-profit at least a year old, in any country. The theme changes each edition; the 2027 one is trees in cities: urban reforestation, native tree nurseries and restoring woodlands, parks and riverbanks.

eligibility.rule: Is a woman of legal age or a collective of women committed to nature conservation in connection with trees
Uses an organisation established for at least 1 year
Leads an initiative that places trees at the heart of cities
